args.body: For SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-RECONCILIATION, read committed TASK-179580996111 and products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/reconciliation/standalone-verification.json and shared-candidate-changes.diff. The exact preview applies to the freshly served baseline and reverses byte for byte. The learner command ran from the exact extracted archive. The shared candidate contains separate bilingual private-quote edits. Coordinate with their owner before combining releases. If the combined scope is unresolved, use the verified standalone patch and payload to close the bounded fallback under a valid lease with a lesson after readback. If a clean release scope is confirmed, obtain the dry-run digest and send the change inventory for host-enforced independent review. Keep the preview staged until that gate is satisfied.

description: Reapplied the bilingual SQLite instructor preview to the freshly fetched live baseline and verified that reversing the patch restores the exact live bytes. The shared site candidate contains separate bilingual private-quote edits, so I staged the preview separately and preserved those edits. Public placement can proceed once the site owner resolves which changes belong in the release and an independent reviewer approves its exact digest.
